window.title: All Things Omarchy
privacy.local: Saved and read status stay on this device.
dashboard.subtitle: Your Omarchy briefing: check your system, catch up, and continue reading.
dashboard.catchUpDescription: New discoveries first, then unread items, balanced across sources. NEW means first discovered in the latest source refresh.
dashboard.caughtUp: No unread items in the loaded feeds. Refresh to check for more.
dashboard.moreUnread: Showing the first %1. Browse a section for more unread items.
dashboard.noEvents: No upcoming events in the loaded feed.
dashboard.queueEmpty: No saved unread items. Save something to come back to it here.
listing.hotkeysDefaults: Official default bindings; your custom shortcuts may differ.
listing.youtubeDates: YouTube dates are approximate; results depend on search indexing.
listing.eventDates: Event times are shown in your local time. Upcoming events appear first.
system.description: Checks the installed Omarchy version and theme. The update check contacts your configured package mirrors and uses a temporary package database; it does not install updates.
system.development: Updates to a development checkout are not checked.
system.versionAvailable: An Omarchy package update is available.
system.updateExplanation: Both update buttons launch the full Omarchy and system update in a terminal, where you can review and confirm it.
system.updateRequested: Update launch requested. Follow the terminal prompts, then refresh this page. If no terminal opens, check %1.
settings.description: Choose how much to show and when to refresh. Feed requests contact the listed public sources; My System checks your configured package mirrors.
settings.sectionDefaults: Restore section defaults and clear filters
settings.clearSavedHelp: Remove every saved item, including items hidden by filters. Read history and cached feeds are preserved.

settings.clearSavedConfirm.one: Remove the saved item? This cannot be undone. Read history and cached feeds will not be removed.
settings.clearSavedConfirm.other: Remove all %1 saved items? This cannot be undone. Read history and cached feeds will not be removed.

settings.refreshHelp: Select sources to refresh when opening. The master switch must be enabled. Manual Refresh always checks all sources; there is no timed background refresh.
settings.systemAuto: Check system updates automatically on open
settings.dashboardHelp: Choose visible panels and use the arrows to reorder them.
settings.filtersHelp: Remember each section's search text, filter chips, and date selection across restarts. Turning this off removes its stored filters, but keeps the current session's filters. Restoring section defaults clears those filters, not saved items or read history.
settings.filterLimit: A section can have up to 16 filter terms. Remove a term before adding another.
settings.filtersTooLarge: Filter preferences are too large to save. Remove some filter terms.
settings.refreshOnOpen: Refresh sources when opening the panel
settings.networkNote: YouTube dates are approximate and results depend on indexing and yt-dlp. Refresh after changing the result limit.
